summary.text: Juanita Albright is the Republican candidate for Indiana State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served on the Hamilton Southeastern Schools board, representing District 2, since 2022.

paragraphs.text: Juanita Albright assumed office on the Hamilton Southeastern Schools board in 2022, and her current term ends in 2026.
In the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 31 she defeated Tiffanie Ditlevson, Travis Hankins and Jan Keefer.
